# table-editing

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-001 — A writer edits a table cell in place and never loses the text](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-001.md) — When a writer in edit mode clicks a cell of a pipe table, the Studio SHALL open an editor for the raw Markdown of that cell inside the cell, growing the cell to fit while the table keeps its layout, save the text shortly after typing stops, keep every change when the writer moves to another cell, commit on Enter, Done or leaving the cell, drop the text on Escape or Cancel, and save the typed text before the preview leaves the document.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-006 — Tab, arrows and editing keys work in a table cell](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-006.md) — When a writer presses Tab, Shift+Tab or an arrow key in a table cell editor, the Studio SHALL move the editor to the next cell in that direction, with Tab in the last cell adding a row, and for Home, End, undo, redo, select all or a wrapping marker act on the text of that cell only.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-008 — A table bar locates the writer and edits rows and columns](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-008.md) — While a writer edits a table cell, the Studio SHALL show a labelled bar of table actions directly above the table with the position of the selected cell, without covering any row, keep it in view for a tall table, and add or remove the row or column next to the selected cell when a row or column button is pressed, keeping the editor open on the new position.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-011 — A table converts between forms and a cell edit is a one-line change](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-011.md) — When a writer asks to convert a table, the Studio SHALL write it in the other form without losing content, or change nothing and say why, and when a writer saves a table edit change only the lines the edit touched and keep the table's padding, alignment, escaping, indentation and line endings.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-012 — Tables and cell text are formatted, inserted, aligned and captioned](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TABLE-012.md) — When a writer applies bold, italic, a link, a colour or another inline format in a table cell editor, or chooses Table, HTML table, Column alignment or Table with caption in the palette or the slash menu, the Studio SHALL change only the cell text and keep the row intact, or insert or change the table at the caret.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
